ModMetaData.name: RimTouch – Windows 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Tatsuki Tanaka; Windows continuation by Sweet Briana and Cinder
ModMetaData.description: Windows touch continuation for RimWorld 1.7. Provides touch selection, UI scrolling, pinch zoom, panning and world-map controls. Enable Harmony separately and only one RimTouch implementation. GPL-3.0-or-later; original author and corresponding source retained. Source: https://github.com/Stella-sea/rimworld-rimtouch
